definitions.gloss: ground blizzard; drifting snow; snow blown along the ground by wind
definitions.explanation: A weather phenomenon where strong winds blow fallen snow along the ground surface, severely reducing visibility. Unlike a regular blizzard, no new snow is falling — it is existing snow being swept up by wind.

examples.japanese: {地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I can't see ahead because of the ground blizzard.

examples.japanese: {地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になった。
examples.english: The road was closed due to the ground blizzard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧しやすく、⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, ground blizzards are common in winter, and caution is needed when driving.

notes:
A compound of {地|じ} (ground) + ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧ (blizzard, snowstorm). Describes a specific type of snow event where wind blows existing snow along the ground.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: for a ground blizzard to occur
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: visibility is poor due to ground blizzard
- {地吹雪|じふぶき}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: ground blizzard advisory
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{地吹雪|じふぶき}: severe ground blizzard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard, snowstorm — a broader term for any heavy snowfall with strong wind
- ⟦{猛吹雪|もうふぶき}→猛吹雪：21266_moufubuki⟧: fierce blizzard — an extremely intense snowstorm
- {風雪|ふうせつ}: wind and snow — a general term for windy, snowy conditions
